name: Simular
summary: Autonomous-computer company behind Sai, a multi-agent platform with a computer fleet: give your AI a Windows, Linux or your own Mac/Windows machine to do digital work.
description: Autonomous-computer company behind Sai, a multi-agent platform with a computer fleet: give your AI a Windows, Linux or your own Mac/Windows machine to do digital work.

pricing.details: Free — daily credit allowance, limited access to a cloud-based Windows computer, create and test workflows, community support (credits refreshed daily; no public euro amount for the daily allowance, because no official amount was published). Pay as you go 45 €/month — 50,000 credits a month (45 € of usage) for AI models and computer time, a dedicated Windows or Linux cloud computer billed only while it runs, up to 5 cloud computers at once, or run Sai on your own Mac or Windows (only AI usage counts), top up anytime, cancel anytime. Sai Unlimited 452 €/month — unlimited AI usage within fair-use guidelines (may shift to efficiency-optimized mode during heavy usage, but never stops), always-on cloud computer included through the end of the billing cycle, or bring your own device, one workspace (additional workspaces upgraded separately), Concierge included. Custom Enterprise on request.
pricing.label: Freemium
